remarks: Build Your Country Dream! Newly surveyed 1.137-acre building lot located on a quiet country road. This lovely, scenic parcel offers a private, treed setting with plenty of country charm. The property was formerly the site of a home and currently has an existing well and septic system on site; seller makes no representations or warranties as to their condition or usability. Public water has recently been installed along the road and is expected to be available for future connection, should the new owner choose to hook up. A beautiful setting with existing infrastructure and future public water potential—bring your plans and make it yours!
